patches_added.name: Rambler stop after silence
patches_added.description: Rambler stops by itself after 3 seconds without speech and keeps the text, as when you tap ✓. Change the time (3, 5, 8 or 10 seconds) or switch it off under Gboard settings → Voice typing → Rambler → Stop after silence. Requires Rambler voice typing.

patches_removed.name: Rambler stop after silence (experimental)
patches_removed.description: Adds Stop after silence to Gboard settings → Voice typing → Rambler. Pick 3, 5, 8 or 10 seconds and Rambler stops by itself once you have said nothing new for that long, keeping the text as when you tap ✓. Off until you pick a time. Requires Rambler voice typing.

patches_modified.name: Disable tracking
patches_modified.description: Disables inventoried native/media collectors, persistent UDS and user-profile identifiers, queued push statistics and known WebView collectors; retains BFF local state, content, login and notification forwarding.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium banner
patches_modified.description: Removes the observed contentBlocker registration/premium notice while retaining ordinary WebAppBlock embeds and NU+ article links. Does not retrieve article bodies omitted by the server.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes DPG banner loading/space, VACS/IMA video ads and explicit sponsored/NUshop content while retaining editorial links and video playlists.

patches_modified.name: Skip consent screens
patches_modified.description: Skips automatic privacy prompts and onboarding offers such as notifications, an account or NUjij as a guest while keeping topic selection, manual settings and consent choices.

patches_added.description: Makes Add to Spotify work in the patched app. The Spotify app turns down a patched TikTok, so you sign in on Spotify's own page instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, put Discover in the bottom bar and Friends in the top tabs, rename the bottom tabs, pick the bottom bar's icons and height, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Hushfeed settings. Find it in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs.

Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Modern UI
patches_modified.description: [v1.3.7: AMOLED black now appears in settings. v1.3.6: Classic Joey can be turned back on. The Joey bird image in sidebar can be toggled on when using ModernUI. Performance improvements for Modern UI. Post style settings are back, without post layout, thumbnail side, or corner roundness. Thumbnail post style ui fixes.] With ModernUI layout turned on (on by default) Joey's own themes and colour changes are turned off. ModernUI layout patch includes Aqua (default), Blue, Purple, Coral, Mint, Gold, Amber, Black, Sky, and AMOLED black themes and can be set in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings. Posts use one compact list, so card and compact are no longer separate. Various customisable UI options are in Morphe Settings. The media viewer has its first UI tweaks in this release, including bigger icons and a full screen view.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Repost, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also keep the Reels tab to accounts you follow, open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, do the same for a reel you open from a link or a chat, play a feed video again right there when you tap Watch again instead of opening Reels, play a video you tap in Saved in the video player instead of Reels, go on to the next reel in Saved instead of a suggested one, keep reels playing without stopping to ask "Are you still watching?", take the UP NEXT bar off the bottom of a video you open from the feed, hide the Fullscreen button under a wide video, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open and of the Reels tab, and show when a reel or video was posted. Its Burn-in guard can fade a reel's buttons, caption and bars when you leave them alone, so they don't burn into the screen. With Turn off HDR brightness patched too, it can show Reels in gray, video and all. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
